name: Serpentine Whip, Greater
body:
School conjuration [poison]; Level: serpent warlock 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5

Components: V,S,M (a shed snake skin)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: 0 ft. (see below)

Effect: 30 ft. long snake-headed whip

Duration: 1 round/level

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: no

This spell is identical to lesser serpentine whip, but the whip can extend up to 30 ft and may deliver up to two poison bites, each of which inflicts 1d8 Con/1d8 Str damage. It may deliver touch spells up to the 6th level.
